sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject: componentYieldSafetyFactor is required on the load-case owner but gen:TRF123LoadCaseShape is never attached to the actual occasional force load-case nodes, so the factor is not required and missing-factor data can pass the readiness check. Apply that node shape (or an equivalent constraint) to the nodes reached through hasOccasionalForceLoadCase, while preserving the existing owner paths, MPa/unitless units, exclusion evidence, DIRECT_CHECK violation comparison, and the prior repair removing minCount from occasionalForceCaseAssessedComponent. No vocabulary matcher is needed.
